newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with not enough slaughter steer or heifer sales confirmed for a market test, USDA said. Inquiry moderate, demand light.

Sales confirmed on 100 mixed steers and heifers Friday. This week's confirmed sales 62,700 head including 17,500 head or about 28 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Bids Friday 63.00, asking 64.00-65.00.
Last sales of consequential numbers, Thursday at 63.00 for both steers and heifers of Select and Choice quality.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink. Confirmed - 100
